policies.five: Only earlier human five-star works displayed when any apply to this category. Old scores remain immutable.
policies.candidates: If no five-star source is documented, show real-source distinct physical paintings; aim for 4-5 but do not invent.
policies.photoVersions: Independent physical-original source photographs only. Variations not based on resizing a single image file.
policies.sourceImage: Some acquisition records have strong exact object and 2500+ px hashes but no public URL; show as linked source-only holds. No screenshots or uncertain image substitutions.
policies.noAutomaticRelease: Do not treat source URL, PDF, cached thumbnail or museum page as licence to publish. No permission requests.
